verify_ssl_disabled.title: TLS verification disabled for {name}
verify_ssl_disabled.description: TLS certificate verification for the BeSMART cloud is disabled for {name}. Credentials and identifiers are sent without verifying the server. Enable 'Verify TLS certificate' in the integration options; keep it disabled only if login fails because of a broken certificate chain.

tls_certificate_error.title: BeSMART cloud certificate could not be verified ({name})
tls_certificate_error.description: Home Assistant could not verify the TLS certificate of the BeSMART cloud for {name}, so it did not send your credentials. If the problem persists and you trust your network, you can disable 'Verify TLS certificate' in the integration options (not recommended).

min_above_max.message: The minimum flow temperature ({min} °C) cannot be higher than the maximum flow temperature ({max} °C) of thermostat {room}. Change the other value first.

boiler_offline.message: The boiler is offline: the settings of thermostat {room} cannot be changed.

settings_read_failed.message: Could not read the current settings of thermostat {room} from the BeSMART cloud. Nothing was sent.

settings_incomplete.message: The BeSMART cloud returned incomplete or out-of-range settings for thermostat {room}. Nothing was sent: try again in a few minutes.

settings_write_failed.message: The BeSMART cloud rejected the new settings of thermostat {room}.

settings_not_confirmed.message: The BeSMART cloud did not confirm the new settings of thermostat {room}. Check the values in the Riello app.
